title: Hold the optical field-tool release while extracting two MTP guide pins
instruction: Hold the black field-tool release. Grip the green pin exchanger and pull it out while keeping the release pressed. Keep clear of the ferrule.
context: Reconfigure a disconnected parallel optical interconnect during compute-cluster servicing.
setup: Cold original two-hand bench fixture. Two nominal 0.70 mm pins at 4.60 mm spacing, separate ferrule witness and green exchanger. Extended black and green grips at Y +106 and -107 mm. The cord and exchanger start inserted.
scoring: 0.20 with both controls held and black travel at least 7 mm. 0.25 per pin following the exchanger within 2 mm beyond 29 mm stroke. Full credit after both are carried past 32 mm, both grips released, and one second of stability. Ferrule touch, loss of the simultaneous hold before extraction clears, or more than 5 mm of pin displacement relative to the exchanger after leaving the hold zeroes the score.
reset_notes: Reseat both pins, insert the disconnected cord and exchanger, zero the release and clear the contact history.
fidelity: Original fixture and enlarged hand controls. The nested latch is a driven surrogate for production tooling. The test begins with both parts inserted. A central optical witness detects robot contact and exchanger contact. Stock exchanger geometry, actual access and handle stroke still require validation.
